# A4 captured-evidence replay — measured exercise, not historical certainty

**Status: acceptance pending fresh independent review.** The former A4 14/14 was not evidence: it injected a record extractor and isolated each week's pool. The committed replacement runs archived bodies through the production `extractRoundupRecords` and actual `verifyRoundupForms` → `planRoundupV2` in one sequential pool. The measured table below is now asserted in the eval. It disagrees with the original §7 projection; no clock, source or expected count was changed to restore that projection. The full September 29 source bodies cannot prove their availability at earlier clocks, so neither a PUBLISH nor a HOLD here is a guaranteed historical decision.

## Provenance and boundary

- `captures.json` pins 12 full, byte-identical raw captures under content-addressed `captures/` with canonical source URL, SHA-256, byte length and capture basis. The three Wayback responses embed/assert their actual instants: Coliseum August 28 23:47:34Z; RBC August 31 20:43:27Z and September 24 17:35:55Z. The nine live bodies (roads, BIA, City 34 Hanna park, BMO, Coliseum, RBC, ExPlace, PWHL, Canada Soccer) have **declared**, not independently logged September 29 instants: generally 18:30Z, ExPlace 19:39:59Z. Original file mtimes around 18:14–18:16Z are not upgraded into pre-15:00Z capture proof. All nine are after every replay clock. The older trial's 14:26 collection note cannot establish byte-identical earlier full bodies.
- `ig-posts.jsonl` commits 32 minimal provider rows with owner, shortcode, timestamp, full raw caption with line breaks, caption SHA-256 and archive filename. Eight pinned original Instagram archive files and all 32 rows were rechecked from `lib_village/.state/archive/2026-09-29-ig-trial/` (set `RV_IG_ARCHIVE` to that path). Full provider dumps and images remain outside the repo.
- The 43 remaining `bodies/` fragments belong to reference rows never fully captured; all carry `bodyKind: fragment` / `unavailable: record-text-fragment`. No counted eligible unit depends on a fragment. They are negative/diagnostic controls, **not** full source-record evidence of an exact reason class.
- The production extractor derives each bound record ID, typed snapshot and quote span from **one** selected body; the verifier re-extracts that same body with no `recordExtractor`, `recordTools` or synthetic geography injected. Source URLs remain canonical (Wayback URLs live only in the manifest). R22/R57 punctuation and R20/R50 place quotes were rederived from verbatim bound-record text; unavailable quotes stay unavailable. R59a/b/c bind to the real ExPlace rows; R59c is planner-held `duplicate-ambiguous` against R59b. `tools/rebuild-conversion.mjs` is deterministic and idempotent.
- Independent A4 diff review `/private/tmp/lv-roundup-v2-A4-real-review.md` verified all 12 original capture bytes and eight Instagram archive pins and found a genuine inherited IG214 conversion defect: the whole-block `place_quote` hid the same-record `📍 116 Atlantic Ave. Patio` line. The rebuild now asserts that exact line and narrows only the quote/span, recording the prior quote in `quoteNotes`. Unchanged production verification admits the captured Oct 3 Burger Drops record as core. Two consecutive rebuilds produced identical conversion SHA-256 `19f26b01e6c66c78c8cbd9a4069a35acb5434482ff1a613163c60aee7f61560e`.

## Clocks and measured captured-evidence table

W37–39 use Wed/Fri/Sun 16:00Z in order; W40 uses Sep 29 15:00Z. Instagram enters after its pinned provider timestamp; a dated news form needs same-record date evidence; listing/feed/org/project records use the latest captured response at or before the slot. A later captured record is offered **only** in its assigned week for an event starting after the slot, with `capturedAfterClock`. The exception is an algorithm exercise, not proof that the response was already live. Feed `createdTime` is never availability proof. A held week adds no coverage; published keys carry into the next week and exclude duplicates. No trap is counted.

The same-record verifier date parser now recognizes unambiguous `Saturday 3 October` without accepting ambiguous numeric dates; the geography parser normalizes the official RBC JSON-LD street address `909 Lakeshore Blvd. W.` to the reviewed adjacent `909 Lake Shore Blvd W` only inside parsed street-address context. Negative tests preserve missing Toronto context, Douro, unknown streets and bare `Lakeshore` refusals. These changes restore actual captured rows, **not** the original projected count.

| Week / clock | Ceiling exercise | Floor exercise | Counted-group reason |
|---|---|---|---|
| W37 Wed Sep 9 | HOLD 5 (0 core / 0 anchors), no-core | same | R09, RBC, and three Coliseum groups are adjacent; no anchor. |
| W37 Fri Sep 11 | HOLD 4 (0/0), no-core | same | Earlier events conclude; no core. |
| W37 Sun Sep 13 | HOLD 4 (0/0), no-core | same | No core. |
| W38 Wed Sep 16 | PUBLISH 5 (1/1) | same | BIA R20 anchor; uncovered RBC and Coliseum groups roll from held W37. |
| W39 Wed/Fri/Sun | HOLD 3 (0/0), no-core at each | same | Adjacent RBC and two Coliseum groups; no core. |
| W40 Tue Sep 29 15:00Z | PUBLISH 10 (2/2), no cap cut | same | IG214 and R50 are core; RBC, ExPlace, BMO and Coliseum are adjacent. |

The ceiling/floor **decisions and counts** coincide but group members differ: R22b and R57b-ii are removed in the floor; R59c and R61 stay uncounted in both. `tests/news-pilot/roundup-v2-backtest.eval.mjs` asserts **every slot's** decision, units/core/anchor counts, ordered constituent unit IDs and absence of cap cuts separately for both scenarios, plus production record binding, capture availability, 3/1 arithmetic, single-pool rollover and no-trap counting. The retained original §7 projected table is printed only for discrepancy analysis, never asserted against these incomplete captures.

## Discrepancies and limits (not adjusted away)

- W37 has no admitted Instagram core anchor. IG065's ordinary caption phrases such as “to LATIN MUSICA” and “on the mat” trigger the existing fail-closed locative guard; IG069's actual `📍 NRG Haus` is not an accepted short venue alias and its collaborator `@` mentions remain fail-closed; IG084 names Liberty Village Park but lacks the required same-record Toronto context (a hashtag `#EcoToronto` is not such context). These are observable product/policy recognition gaps, not missing archived captions. No unknown place, off-site mention or ambiguous identity was silently admitted to force W37 to publish.
- Because W37 holds, the genuine August 28 Coliseum capture rolls uncovered rows into W38. R20 makes W38 publish; the original projection assumed those rows had been covered by W37. W39 retains three adjacent units but no core. IG193's day-first **date layer** now resolves, but its `Where: @nrghaus` venue/handle layer remains unverified. R37's September 29 Canada Soccer revision has a visible same-record `<time>24/09/2026</time>`, but no pre-September-25 revision capture; its date grammar also does not support numeric DD/MM/YYYY. Fact (ii) remains unavailable in ceiling and floor—never inferred from serialized JSON-LD or a later page.
- W40's R52/R53/R54 restrictions started **before** the 15:00Z slot and appear only in the later roads capture, so the existing future-start exception cannot admit them. IG215's QUEST nickname/registry venue layer is unverified; IG214 is now valid via its actual location line. R58's reviewed RBC address now verifies as adjacent; R56a/R56b remain counted, not cap-cut. R61 lacks a visible dateline. Do not extend the roads exception or backdate the City feed solely to match the old table.
- The exact historical reason classes for fragment-only R03, R23, R44 and other uncaptured traps cannot be proved by A4. Separately, a **post-capture real-feed** test runs R62 Joe Shuster Way, R63 Temple Ave and R64 Douro St through production extraction/verifier at Sep 29 19:00Z and asserts `not-LV`; they were excluded by availability from earlier slots and are not represented as historical W40 verifier decisions. A2's synthetic negative/clock controls test rules in isolation, not real-source history. A4 does not claim the old IG084-removal sensitivity: IG084 is already excluded; `roundup-plan.test.mjs` independently proves the synthetic 3/1 no-core gate.
